variant_note: Dismounted squad (otdeleniye) of a BMP-mounted motor rifle platoon of the Russian Ground Forces in Ratnik kit: AK-74M (AK-12 in some units), 6B47 helmet, 6B45 body armour, EMR uniform. Dimensions describe one soldier.

armament.main: AK-74M 5.45 mm assault rifle (AK-12 5.45 mm issued first to elite units), some with GP-30 40 mm underbarrel grenade launchers
armament.secondary: RPK-74M or PKP Pecheneg machine gun; RPG-7V grenadier with an assistant

protection: 6B47 aramid helmet (Ratnik; successor of the 6B7-1M / 6B27, NVG mount); 6B45 body armour with MOLLE front (7.5 kg, GOST class 6); lighter 6B46 plate carrier
notes: Dimensions are for one soldier in full kit. crew = 6 dismounts: a fire group (squad leader, RPG-7V grenadier, assistant grenadier, machine gunner) and a manoeuvre group (2 riflemen with GP-30). The BMP gunner and driver stay in the vehicle. Squads in Ukraine are often reported at 5–7 men.
silhouette_features: rounded full-cut aramid helmet (6B47) with an EMR cover
bulky 6B45 body armour with MOLLE pouches on the front and a high collar
AK-profile rifle: curved magazine, gas tube over the barrel, folding stock
grenadier with an RPG-7V tube and its conical warhead over the shoulder
EMR digital camouflage (small green / brown / black pixels on a light green base)
details: GP-30 underbarrel launcher on one or two rifles
camo_note: EMR ("Tsifra" / Digital Flora) digital camouflage, used with the Ratnik kit; the helmet has an EMR cover
